scripts.up:sonar: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sonar up -d --build sonarqube
scripts.down: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sonar down
scripts.logs: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile sonar logs -f
scripts.up:prod: docker compose --env-file infra/.env.prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.down:prod: docker compose --env-file infra/.env.prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.logs:prod: docker compose --env-file infra/.env.prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f
scripts.waf:up: docker compose -p safeline --env-file infra/safeline/.env -f infra/safeline/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.waf:down: docker compose -p safeline --env-file infra/safeline/.env -f infra/safeline/compose.yaml down
